question:
Suppose there are \(k\) teams playing a round robin tournament; that is, each team plays against all the other teams and no game ends in a draw. Suppose the \(i^{\text{th}}\) team loses \(l_i\) games and wins \(w_i\) games. Show that
\[
\sum_{i=1}^k l_i^2=\sum_{i=1}^k w_i^2.
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
